scope: real rsync acceptance definitions; argv doubles do not satisfy these

scenarios.given: three-day synthetic ordinary media and real delivered planner view
scenarios.then: one actual media rsync; three-day destination leaves are ordinary files with exact content; private capability rsync counted separately

scenarios.given: same source path,size,mtime and different bytes
scenarios.then: quick may skip and must not claim full verification; checksum updates and retains old bytes in owner replaced directory

scenarios.given: only mtime changed beyond comparison precision then unchanged rerun
scenarios.then: quick may retain same-content old file; checksum updates attributes without replaced; unchanged rerun neither mode creates replacement
same route; partial separated from formal file; no ignore-existing or append flags; do not promise byte delta resume

scenarios.given: ENOSPC, backup-dir write failure or interrupted partial
scenarios.then: nonzero; old file retention checked with actual bytes; no completed; partial/replaced recoverable

scenarios.given: large unchanged source and default automatic quick
scenarios.then: NUL argv lacks checksum; no second content comparer/hash; metadata I/O accounted separately from rsync update comparison
